title: Made my own RTS, Navastorm, and its free on Google Play
author: Comfortable-Lab-9035
selftext:
I made Navastorm with an idea on mind...

I like RTS games, but due to adulthood, i have few time for matches. I enganged with Pokemon Unite stile short matches....

However, this is a RTS game designed for short matches, or as long as you want, I put some touches so you can control how agressive the IA could be. 

Units: mostly navals, some grounds to support, combat planes, I liked the mythical creatures on Age of Mythology and decided to add mytical creatures, dragons, krakens.

Most of the gameplays the coins are fixes, you start with enough coins to do something and take down the enemy float (be careful with the planes, IA sometimes went out of control when I tell it to optimize the combat) but the player always have some advantage when comes to 1-1 combat, as hard difficult comes, that benefit decrease, but even in hard, you have some advantage. 

I was thinking the way to control big groups of units, and the way I like RTS games, so here is the basic to play:

double tap to open a rectangle selection. Clic on any unit of that selection will form a group. A unit can belong to 1 group only. you can command a group by selecting any unit of that group. 

With the basics, the real thing, my fav. its Conquest+, you and your enemy receive coins every X mins (default 5 but customizable) just to build an army and go to war. Wins when you destroy every enemy.

Units... engineer and cientific units, engineer takes builds with no owner, and enemy builds with less than 50% health. Engineers heals other units, one at the time. Cientific units do the same, but with mytical habitats and creatures. 

Designed to make matches as fast as 10min or take the time to build and make it suffer as much as you want.

AI workflow: Unity + C#. Most of the code was written with Claude Code and Codex (Opus 5.5 xhigh + sol 6.1 xhigh, but mostly Opus). The 3D models come from Blender Python scripts the agents wrote, not hand-modeled.

It has a tutorial with the basics anyways

It's free on Google Play: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.navastorm.game](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.navastorm.game)

I'd love feedback, especially on balance and controls. Happy to answer anything about the workflow!
